normal_civic_discussion_v1.name: Normal Civic Discussion
normal_civic_discussion_v1.description: Ordinary civic discussion period with broad tolerance for critique, satire, prediction, and non-actionable political speech.

rules.ballot_validity: Allow educational or critical discussion. Intervene when content spreads harmful false claims about whether ballots count.
rules.satire: Allow satire and commentary, but act on content that could mislead voters about election access.
rules.counting_process: Allow opinion and analysis about counting. Intervene when content misstates official election results or counting status.

election_integrity_period_v2.name: Election Integrity Period
election_integrity_period_v2.description: Heightened period where misleading election procedure, ballot validity, official notice, and counting claims require stricter treatment.

rules.ballot_validity: False ballot validity claims are high priority during the integrity period. Preserve corrective education but intervene on harmful misinformation.
rules.satire: Satire is allowed when it is clearly not deceptive. Intervene on official-looking or confusing election notices.
rules.counting_process: Claims about active counting and certification require care. Intervene on false claims about official status or rejected ballots.
